Implementation in worktree ../split-inbound-differ-64ae (branch split-inbound-differ-64ae).

CONCERN BOUNDARY CHOSEN — collection-valued diffs vs scalar-field diff + orchestration.
The four helpers that fill InboundMutation.comments/.labels/.links (_diff_comments_inbound,
_diff_labels_inbound, _diff_links_inbound, _diff_link_removals_inbound) move to a new sibling
leaf src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/inbound_collection_diffs.py, together with the private
helpers only they use (_load_link_direction/_LINK_DIR_KEY/_LinkDirModule, RECONCILER_MARKER,
_EXCLUDED_PREFIXES). Call-graph evidence: each of the four has EXACTLY ONE caller
(compute_inbound_mutations) and no other caller anywhere in the package (Serena
find_referencing_symbols + string grep both confirm); they reference nothing else in the module;
and _load_link_direction/RECONCILER_MARKER/_EXCLUDED_PREFIXES are referenced by nothing outside
that set — so the extracted set is closed and the seam is the one the call graph already had.
They also share one signature shape ((jira_fields, local_ticket, ...) -> list[dict] records)
against the scalar half's -> dict.

SIZES: inbound_differ.py 800 -> 540 (260 lines / 32% headroom under the 800 cap);
inbound_collection_diffs.py 312. No file under 100 LOC. module-size-limit.txt untouched.

WHY _diff_jira_vs_local DID NOT MOVE: it carries a .github/complexity-baseline.json entry
(inbound_differ.py::_diff_jira_vs_local = 16). The baseline key is path-qualified, so moving it
would delete one key and ADD another, and the semantic shrink-only LOCK (task 47e9) REJECTS any
added entry without an administrator override. Moving it is therefore not a contributor-level
change. Ratchet after this split: active=49 new=0 increased=0 stale=0.

PATH-KEYED REGISTRY UPDATED IN THE SAME CHANGE (the Gerrit-1916 lesson): the ADF allowlist in
tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py::_ADF_ALLOWLIST is a raw-substring gate
keyed by filename. The extracted module tripped it purely because _load_link_direction's docstring
said 'mirrors _load_adf' — a prose mention, not a reference. Fixed honestly by rewording the
docstring (naming the loader by description) rather than by widening the allowlist, which would
have permitted a real future ADF reach in that file. Registries checked and found NOT to need
changes: .github/complexity-baseline.json (the only inbound_differ entry stays put),
tests/scripts/test_reconciler_core_seam_clean_heldout.py _OWNED_FILES/_MARKER_BUDGET/
_TOTAL_MARKER_CAP (inbound_differ carries zero '# read-via:' markers; the new file adds none),
test_backend_neutrality.py _MAPPER_INJECTED / _SWEEP_EXEMPTIONS / _ZERO_ADAPTER_IMPORT_SCALAR_CORE,
and tests/module_size_support.py (computed dynamically, no registry). One stale prose citation
updated: test_inbound_link_lands_locally_5200.py's docstring pointed at 'inbound_differ.py:362-418'
for a function that no longer lives there (docstring only — no assertion touched).

GATES LOCAL: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (569 files), tests/unit/rebar_reconciler 2967
passed (baseline 2952 + 15 new seam tests; ZERO existing tests modified), tests/scripts +
module-size + metrics 1207 passed / 2 skipped. Full default suite running.
